Name: Turn on the Lights
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
A little mod that adds glow to lamps, sconces, and other indoor environmental features that ought to glow. Works with 1.6.

[left]﻿
﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/hmwLlHj.png[/img][/left][list]
[*]This mod adds extra lighting to 19 interior maps. Each one can be individually toggled on or off.
[/list][list]
[*]I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.﻿
[/list][center]﻿[/center][left][img]https://i.imgur.com/asdbu7v.png[/img]﻿[/left][list]
[*]As of version 1.2 of this mod, compatibility with Stardew Valley Expanded is improved. This mod is not designed for SVE's maps, and will place lights where lamps are in the base game regardless of if SVE has moved them. However, crashes and conflicting data are no longer a risk. Any maps that SVE changes enough for this to be noticeable can be toggled off.
[/list][list]
[*]Mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/110631873?tab=user+files]Orenciel[/url]﻿'s Less Ugly Series should now be more compatible for the reasons above.
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿, and other recolour mods that change the look of the map [b]without changing the layout[/b] are fully compatible. 
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Now with new lighting data appended to existing data, instead of replacing it. This vastly increases compatibility with other mods that edit map lighting.
